incident_report.incident: Raced wide and without cover until near the 600 Metres.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Sent for sampling post-race.
Sent for sampling post-race.

K Teetan stated that his instructions were to hold a more forward position but despite riding his mount along in the early stages it did not show sufficient pace to do so, particularly when it was bumped by WAH MAY WAI WAI which shifted out after travelling a short distance.
Bumped shortly after the start.
Jumped only fairly.

After travelling a short distance shifted out and away from ROMANTIC FANTASY, resulting in its rider Apprentice E C W Wong having to correct his mount.  For some distance near the 700 Metres raced keenly and was steadied away from WAH MAY WAI WAI.  When questioned regarding his riding in the middle stages and as to whether there was an opportunity to hold his position to the outside of WAH MAY WAI WAI, Apprentice E C W Wong stated that his instructions were to go forward.  He said when the early stages of the event were being run inside of standard time he elected to hold a trailing position behind WAH MAY WAI WAI on the rail.  He said near the 1000 Metres as the pace of the event steadied his mount commenced to race keenly and as a result he was eased to avoid WAH MAY WAI WAI which resulted in his mount shifting out and being positioned to the outside of that runner.  He said as the early stages were run inside of standard time and his mount has a tendency to hang in, he repositioned his mount behind WAH MAY WAI WAI to ensure it raced tractably and to provide it with the best opportunity to finish the race off in the Home Straight.  He added after being briefly held up making the Home Turn SUPER SICARIO finished the race off in a one-paced manner.  The Stewards advised Apprentice Wong that, in their opinion, he would have been better suited by holding his position to the outside of WAH MAY WAI WAI, however, having regard to his explanation, they found the tactics he adopted were reasonable in the circumstances.

Approaching the 500 Metres was checked when crowded between MAGIC COSMOS which shifted out making the turn and CARRYON SMILING which raced tight to the inside of ROMANTIC FANTASY (A Badel) when that runner shifted in.  A Badel was reprimanded and advised he must ensure that he leaves sufficient room for runners to his inside.
No report.

After travelling a short distance shifted out and made contact with GOLD TACK.  M L Yeung could offer no excuse for his mount giving ground in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

J Orman stated that his instructions were to hold a more forward position but when his mount jumped only fairly it settled further back in the field than intended.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Bumped shortly after the start.  Making the turn approaching the 500 Metres shifted out and made slight contact with LEATHER MASTER.  The performance of MAGIC COSMOS, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, MAGIC COSMOS will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Sent for sampling post-race.
Shortly after the start was bumped on the hindquarters and became unbalanced.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Between the 300 Metres and the 250 Metres had difficulty obtaining clear running when being shifted to the outside of AMAZING KID.
Shifted in shortly after the start and was bumped.
Made contact with a rail entering the Parade Ring, was examined by the Veterinary Officer on arrival at the Start and passed suitable to race.  Jumped only fairly.
No report.
Stood flat-footed as the start was effected and lost ground.  Before being allowed to race again, VIGOR ELLEEGANT will be required to perform satisfactorily in a stalls test.
Badly crowded shortly after the start.  Approaching the 250 Metres had difficulty obtaining clear running when being shifted to the outside of BIG RETURN.
Shortly after the start was bumped on the hindquarters and became unbalanced when crowded between CELESTIAL STRIDER and MASTER RESOLUTE.

Bumped shortly after the start.  When questioned Z Purton stated that making the first turn his mount changed stride and became awkward in its action.  He said after this RUN RUN SMART did not travel well and when he was concerned there was something amiss with the horse he eased it down in the Home Straight when it commenced to give ground.  Trainer F C Lor advised the horse had pleased him leading into the race and he had not identified any issue with its action in training.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of RUN RUN SMART was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, RUN RUN SMART will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Jumped only fairly and shortly after the start was severely checked when crowded between SPEEDY TRIDENT and MARVEL AND GOLD which was taken out by LUCKY TWENTY.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Shifted out shortly after the start, was bumped and became unbalanced.  Apprentice E C W Wong reported that when under pressure in the Home Straight he was concerned with his mount’s action and as a consequence he eased it down when not in a competitive position.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Before being allowed to race again, LUCKY TWENTY will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Near the 1400 Metres was eased to avoid AEROINVINCIBLE.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Jumped only fairly.  After being held up for clear running leaving the 400 Metres was then checked passing the 350 Metres to avoid ZHOU GONGJIN which commenced to give ground quickly.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Jumped only fairly.
No report.
Jumped only fairly.

Near the 1400 Metres, when racing keenly, was steadied to avoid KA YING GLORY (K Teetan) which shifted in when not quite clear.  K Teetan was advised to exercise more care.  Continued to race keenly in the middle stages.

Between the 300 Metres and the 150 Metres was held up for clear running. Again for a short distance near the 100 Metres was held up behind THE AZURE.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Jumped awkwardly.  R Kingscote stated that he was instructed to take up a forward position with his mount stepping up in distance.

M L Yeung could offer no real excuse for the performance other than the horse did not appear to be comfortable racing in amongst other horses.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

A Atzeni stated that he was under the instructions to ensure that he led the event.  He said as a result ICONICAL set a pace inside of standard time throughout the early stages and was left without a finishing effort in the Home Straight.  Trainer J Richards confirmed the instructions were to show intent to lead the event but, in his opinion, the pace of the early stages was too quick.  He added that ICONICAL was also disadvantaged by being pressured in the lead by WAVE GARDEN.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

The performance of ZHOU GONGJIN, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, ZHOU GONGJIN will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

K Teetan stated that his mount hung out badly throughout the event and as a result he was unable to ride the horse in a competitive manner.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to be a "roarer” which had previously been reported.  The racing manners and performance of KA YING GLORY, which finished tailed out, were considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, KA YING GLORY will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial around a bend in Hong Kong and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Bumped at the start.  Near the 1100 Metres was bumped by ACE POWER which shifted in.  Near the 700 Metres shifted out slightly and made contact with SUPERB BOY.  Sent for sampling post-race.

After being crossed by MEGA BONUS near the 1000 Metres commenced to race keenly and making the first turn shifted out when being checked to avoid MEGA BONUS.  Near the 700 Metres became unbalanced when bumped by JOLLY COMPANION which shifted out slightly.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Bumped at the start.  Near the 1100 Metres shifted in and bumped JOLLY COMPANION.  Between the 300 Metres and the 100 Metres was held up for clear running.
No report.

Making the first turn was hampered when taken wider by SUPERB BOY.  As a result SAVVY TWINKLE then commenced to race keenly and got its head up when being shifted behind SUPERB BOY to obtain cover.  After obtaining cover behind SUPERB BOY, SAVVY TWINKLE, which continued to race keenly, again got its head up when being checked to avoid SUPERB BOY near the 650 Metres.  Shifted out near the 450 Metres and made contact with GREAT STATE.
Trainer M Newnham advised that from an outside barrier he had instructed for the horse to be ridden in a conservative manner in the early stages.
No report.
Held up making the Home Turn.  M F Poon reported that his mount was fractious in the gates, jumped only fairly and as a result settled back in the field.
Jumped awkwardly.  In the middle stages raced keenly and after being crossed by SAVVY TWINKLE near the 800 Metres was steadied to avoid that runner.
Shifted in at the start, made contact with CAP LINER and became unbalanced.

A Atzeni stated that from the inside barrier his mount jumped only fairly and as a result he had to make some use of it in the early stages to hold an on-pace position.  He said as a consequence in the Home Straight his mount was left without a finishing effort.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to have blood in the mouth.

Near the 450 Metres was hampered when taken wider by SAVVY TWINKLE which shifted out when racing keenly.  Raced very wide and without cover for the majority of the event before giving ground in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Sent for sampling post-race.
On jumping shifted out, made heavy contact with TAKE ACTION and became badly unbalanced.  Shortly after the start was hampered when taken out by QUICK CONTRIBUTION.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Jumped only fairly.
On jumping shifted out and away from SUPERB GUY and made heavy contact with QUICK CONTRIBUTION.

Bumped heavily on jumping.  After travelling a short distance was steadied when crowded between BULL ATTITUDE and VIVACIOUS WIN which was taken out by QUICK CONTRIBUTION.  For a short distance near the 250 Metres had difficulty obtaining clear running when positioned behind SUPERB GUY.  Near the 150 Metres raced tight to the inside of SUPERB GUY.
Bumped near the 300 Metres.

On jumping was bumped heavily by CAN’T GO WONG which shifted out and shortly after was then crowded between CAN’T GO WONG and VIVACIOUS WIN which shifted in after making heavy contact with TAKE ACTION.

Raced keenly in the middle stages.  Z Purton could offer no explanation for the horse’s disappointing performance.  Trainer M Newnham stated that he expected the horse to hold a midfield position but due to the early and middle stages being run outside of standard time BULL ATTITUDE raced keenly and as a consequence found it difficult to make up ground in the Home Straight. A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Near the 300 Metres made contact with GENERAL REDWOOD when attempting to shift to the outside of STORMI to obtain clear running.  J Orman reported that his mount travelled reasonably well during the early and middle stages but in the Home Straight did not respond to his riding and was disappointing.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

M Guyon stated that the instructions were to hold a midfield position.  He said although the pace of the event was run outside of standard time throughout the middle stages he was content to allow the horse to remain racing wide and without cover as he felt this would provide the horse with the best opportunity to finish the race off.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to have a heart condition which required further assessment. <19/1/2026 Additional Veterinary Report> A further assessment of the heart condition did not reveal any significant findings.

Raced keenly in the middle stages and for some distance near the 800 Metres was steadied away from BULL ATTITUDE.  C Y Ho advised that from a wide barrier he was instructed to ride the horse in a conservative manner in the early stages to ensure it ran out the 1650 Metres of tonight’s race.  Trainer K L Man confirmed the instructions and said he issued those instructions as UP WITH CHARM did not finish the race off when it led at its last race start on 17 December 2025.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Sent for sampling post-race.

Shifted in at the start and was bumped.  L Ferraris stated that from a wide barrier he was instructed to go forward on his mount.  He said when HONEST WITNESS showed good pace in the early stages he was able to cross to the front and lead.  Trainer D A Hayes confirmed the instructions issued.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Bumped on jumping.  Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.

C L Chau was found guilty of a careless riding charge for causing interference shortly after the start (see TACTICAL COMMAND).  When questioned C L Chau stated that the instructions were to attempt to hold an on-pace position.  He said in the early stages FLYING WROTE did not show sufficient pace to do so and raced in a similar manner to when it barrier trialed on 29 December 2025 when it settled back in the field.  He said as a consequence FLYING WROTE settled in a midfield position behind FORTUNE WARRIOR and after improving to that runner’s outside approaching the 400 Metres his mount finished the race off well when under pressure in the Home Straight.
A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Jumped only fairly.  Raced keenly in the middle stages and after the 800 Metres was steadied to avoid FLYING WROTE.  Whilst the Stewards were satisfied that the riding of B Avdulla, 7th placegetter, over the concluding stages did not affect the horse’s finishing position, he was nonetheless reminded of his obligation to ensure that he fully rides his mounts out to the finish of the race.

C L Chau (FLYING WROTE) was found guilty of a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that shortly after the start he allowed his mount to shift in when not clear of SMART FIGHTER, resulting in SMART FIGHTER being crowded in onto TACTICAL COMMAND which was checked when it lost its rightful running between SMART FIGHTER and STRAIGHT TO GLORY.  C L Chau was suspended from riding in races for one Hong Kong raceday to be conducted on Wednesday, 28 January 2026 at Happy Valley.  In addition, Jockey Chau was fined $45,000.  In assessing penalty, the Stewards determined the carelessness grade 1 and the consequences grade 2 and also considered his neutral race riding record.
Jumped only fairly and shortly after the start became unbalanced when crowded between TACTICAL COMMAND and FLYING WROTE.
No report.
Jumped only fairly and then was crowded between VOYAGE BOSS and HONEST WITNESS, both of which shifted ground.
From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Shortly after the start bumped heavily with FIERY STEED when both runners shifted ground.  Sent for sampling post-race.
On jumping was bumped by ETERNAL FORTUNE which shifted out slightly.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Shifted out at the start and was bumped.
No report.
No report.
Leaving the 600 Metres was steadied to avoid WHIZZ KID when racing keenly.  Lay in over the final 150 Metres.
Jumped only fairly.  Leaving the 100 Metres was eased and shifted to the inside of METRO POWER to continue into clear running.
Jumped only fairly.  Leaving the 150 Metres was briefly crowded between RED ELEGANCE and BUNDLE OF CHARM.
When giving ground near the 100 Metres was steadied when crowded between RED ELEGANCE and WHIZZ KID.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
M F Poon reported that on jumping he became unbalanced, resulting in his left foot being dislodged from his stirrup for a short distance and his mount losing ground.

Near the 100 Metres made contact with HARMONY N BLESSED when racing tight between HARMONY N BLESSED and BLUE ILLUSION.  H Bowman stated that his instructions were to settle where comfortable but attempt to hold a handy position.  He said when RED ELEGANCE commenced well he was able to settle in a forward position.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Jumped only fairly and shortly after the start bumped heavily with LOVE TOGETHER when both runners shifted ground.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings. <8/1/2026 Additional Veterinary Reports> After the race, FIERY STEED was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said at that time there were no significant findings. FIERY STEED was again examined by the Veterinary Officer at the stables of Trainer P F Yiu this morning. He said at this time he noted the horse to be lame in its right front leg. Before being allowed to race again, FIERY STEED will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

On jumping made contact with REFUSETOBEENGLISH due to both runners shifting ground.  After travelling a short distance became unbalanced when it made contact with PRESTIGE SUPERIOR which shifted in slightly.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Sent for sampling post-race.
Jumped only fairly and then made contact with PERFECT GENERAL due to both runners shifting ground.
Briefly held up for clear running making the Home Turn before shifting to the outside of SPICY GOLD entering the Home Straight.  Near the 150 Metres M Chadwick dropped his whip.
No report.
No report.
Jumped awkwardly and lost ground.
Shortly after the start raced ungenerously when being steadied to attempt to obtain cover.  When unable to obtain cover CHARMING BABE raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.

C L Chau stated that the instructions were to hold an on-pace position.  He said when TRIUMPHANT MORE did not show sufficient pace in the early stages to comply with those instructions he then elected to steady his mount to obtain cover behind CHARMING BABE to avoid racing wide and without cover, which resulted in his mount racing ungenerously for some distance near the 900 Metres.  He added in the Home Straight TRIUMPHANT MORE finished the race off fairly.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

A Badel stated that he was obliged to make some use of the horse in the early stages to take up a position with cover behind the leaders.  He said in the Home Straight SPICY GOLD did not respond strongly to his riding and raced in a disappointing manner.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Jumped only fairly.
Shifted in shortly after the start and made contact with PERFECT GENERAL.

Making the Home Turn became unbalanced when it made contact with CORLEONE whilst being shifted to the outside of ANOTHER ZONDA to obtain clear running.  Between the 300 Metres and the 200 Metres was held up for clear running when improving into a narrow run between KING LOTUS and CORLEONE which shifted in slightly and as a result made contact with CORLEONE near the 200 Metres.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Shifted out at the start and was bumped.  Near the 350 Metres was bumped by SOLID WIN.  Bumped by SOLID WIN near the 200 Metres.  When questioned M Guyon stated that approaching the 500 Metres his mount commenced to race keenly when BEAUTY GLORY was unable to quicken.  He said as a result he shifted to the outside of BEAUTY GLORY and was then checked to avoid ANOTHER ZONDA when that runner did not improve into the race.  He said as a consequence he was obliged to shift out to avoid ANOTHER ZONDA and made contact with LOCH TAY.  M Guyon was advised in similar circumstances to exercise more care and to ensure that he gives his mounts sufficient clearance from runners in front when shifting ground.  Sent for sampling post-race.

On jumping was crowded between ANOTHER ZONDA and BEAUTY GLORY which was taken out.  Held up making the Home Turn and near the 350 Metres was steadied to avoid SOLID WIN.  Approaching the 100 Metres raced tight between LO PAN SPIRIT and KING LOTUS when improving into a narrow run between those runners and as a result made contact with LO PAN SPIRIT.
Shortly after the start became unbalanced when it was bumped by LOCH TAY. L Hewitson was reprimanded for using the whip on consecutive occasions in 2 consecutive strides after the 200 Metres.
From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.

Jumped awkwardly, shifted out and made heavy contact with BEAUTY GLORY.  After the 500 Metres shifted out abruptly when improving to the outside of FANTASTIC FUN.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Raced wide and without cover throughout the early and middle stages.  From the 700 Metres was ridden forward where it obtained the lead passing the 600 Metres.  Bumped near the 100 Metres.
Approaching the 500 Metres was hampered when taken wider by LOCH TAY.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

On jumping became unbalanced when bumped by CORLEONE which shifted out.  Approaching the 500 Metres was steadied when crowded by CORLEONE which shifted out abruptly when being checked to avoid ANOTHER ZONDA.
Jumped only fairly.  Held up for clear running between the 300 Metres and the 200 Metres.
A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Bumped heavily on jumping.  Y L Chung stated that he had to make some use of his mount in the early stages to lead which resulted in the pace of the event being run inside of standard time.  He said as a result BEAUTY GLORY was unable to run on in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
